And the Summons with the Obedience [constitute] twenty-five characteristics in their twenty-five limbs, [which] are the sons of the Man. So, from that time until [the time] of [the adv]ent of Jesus the Splendour, the glorious one who came [and gave to them t]heir food which is the [light] of sou[l], which is the Summons and the Obedience [that became] that spiritual food.
